subject: Staff Readout: Key OKR signals, QBR asks, and escalation lane
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam@gravity.ai>, Isha Ramanathan <isha@novastream.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staff Readout: Key OKR signals, QBR asks, and escalation lane

Team —

Quick readout to surface signal for this week and capture a few concrete asks ahead of the QBR pack deadline (end of week). Attaching the one-pager and the latest OKR snapshot.

Wins
- Inference throughput pilot (dedicated pool) validated at target 95th p90 for Gen2 models; throughput improvement ~18% vs baseline. Engineering and Infra delivered the rollout plan on schedule.
- CS completed two high-value POCs with Gravity AI; positive feedback on latency and cost projections.

Risks / Open signals
- Model fallbacks: we observed a regression in a small class of long-context prompts after last kernel swap. Root cause: KV cache eviction timing mismatch; engineering has a patch but we need extra test coverage before a full rollout. Impact: potential QoS hits (~2% of traffic) until mid-next-week.
- QBR narrative: we do not yet have a defensible cost-per-conversation number for Dedicated customers (missing steady-state projection). Finance has asked for clearer unit economics by Wednesday.

Asks (actionable)
- Markus: confirm rollout freeze window for the kernel patch (proposal: deploy to canary Tues evening; hold wide rollout until test pass).
- Laura: can CS own validation plan for Gravity AI's remaining POC scenarios this week? I will add Sam to the validation plan thread.
- Aditya: please prepare a short slide with steady-state unit economics for Dedicated (include batch sizes + cache hit assumptions) by Wed EOD.

Attachments: QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf, OKR_snapshot_202703.xlsx

High-level next steps: Patch -> Canary -> validate with CS -> full rollout OR rollback. I will keep the exec distro posted with any change to impact.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staff Readout: Key OKR signals, QBR asks, and escalation lane

Thanks Mina — quick notes: 

1) Rollout freeze window is fine. Can we tighten the canary to only run in N. Virginia region for 48 hours (reduce blast radius)? If yes I approve.

2) On the KV cache regression: if the patch is low-risk, prioritize getting it through canary fast. If it touches GPU kernels, hold until we have end-to-end perf traces.

Please add the proposed canary region and the expected validation metrics (latency p95/p99 + cache hit %) in the canary plan doc.

-Markus

Thanks all — short update and action list (putting deadlines where helpful):

Decisions
- Canary scope: N. Virginia only, 48 hours (approved).
- Rollout gating: must pass perf traces + cache hit >= 92% on canary before wide rollout.

Action items
- Engineering (Jonas / Markus): create canary runbook with expected metrics + dashboard links by Tue 09:00 PT. (Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QBRexample)
- CS (Laura): run the 6 POC scenarios with Gravity this week; report results in the shared sheet by Thu 17:00 PT.
- Finance/Product (Aditya): cost slide for dedicated steady-state assumptions by Wed EOD.
- Ops (Mina): if canary fails, pause and notify exec distro; if it passes, schedule full rollout with support on standby.

Sam/Isha — we appreciate your flexibility on validation scheduling. Sam, can your team confirm availability Tue/Wed morning PT for two validation windows?

I'll update the QBR one-pager with the decisions and the mitigation bullets, then distribute the final pack Thu morning.

Thanks,
Mina

Attachments referenced: QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf, OKR_snapshot_202703.xlsx
